title: Perioperative Transcutaneous Electrical Acupoint Stimulation for Postoperative Pain Relief Following Laparoscopic Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
comparator: SSS brief minimal perceptible current sham5min each session; electrodes30min
population: Adults18–70 GA laparoscopic cholecystectomy/gynecological; Zhejiang July2012–Oct2013.
rescue_regimen: IV flurbiprofen50mg surgery end then50mg forVAS≥4/request within48h; none >1 supplement. Tropisetron5mg at end and5mg rescue vomiting/persistent nausea2h.
independence: One4-arm trial; SSS shared across3 active schedules; parent must select schedule or valid multiarm method. TSSpreonly,TTSpre+intra,TSTpre+post.
source_conflicts: ClinicalTrials.gov named but ChiCTR identifier given; identifier2015 postdates2012–2013 study.
Percentage CIs not SDs/counts. Categorical counts could be reconstructed only with explicit rounding verification and labeling.
Morphine mg/kg is author conversion intraop, not administered morphine or postop.
